newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Ciba Specialty shoots for 18-20 pct EBITDA.
newsitem.headline: Ciba Specialty shoots for 18-20 pct EBITDA.

text.p: Ciba Specialty Chemicals Holding Inc Chairman Rolf Meyer said the company aimed to boost earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortisation (EBITDA) to 18 to 20 percent of sales.

"This is what we are striving for in the medium term," he told reporters, adding the company being spun off by Novartis had 13.8 percent EBITDA over the past three years and 15.8 percent in the first half of 1996.

But he said the ratio tends to dip in the second half of the year, so that operating profit would improve marginally in full-year 1996 from 1995. Ciba posted 499 million francs in operating profit in 1995 on sales of 6.50 billion.

Finance chief Michael Jacobi said the company had been able to boost its operating margin to 7.7 percent in 1995 from 6.8 percent in 1993 at a time the dollar depreciated 20 percent against the Swiss franc
He also said the company was poised to benefit from the weaker Swiss franc because around nine percent of its sales and 28 percent of its costs were in the currency.
